Independent finite check: modular Eulerian recurrence for descents 0,1,2 through n=k+4·3^k−1; compare histogram with directly counted square roots and the odd center from the log series and digit lifting; test both maximal proper period divisors
correctness.rationale: For n≥k, 3^n vanishes modulo 3^k and separating parity gives precisely g_0 and g_1. The restricted power series for 4^t has all its positive-degree coefficients divisible by 3; the first and second derivative reductions of the branches are t−1 and 1. Each noncritical input disc maps isometrically onto the stated residue ball. The simple derivative roots lift uniquely; in the even branch both factors vanish at −1/2 because 4^(−1/2) is the square root of 1/4 congruent to 1. For the odd center g_1(1)=−26≡1 mod 9 and moving to its critical point does not change this residue. At each critical point substitute t=β+3s: after removing 9s² the Taylor quotient is 2 modulo 3 as a restricted series. Dividing by 2 and taking the square root congruent to 1 yields a coordinate congruent coefficientwise to s modulo 3, hence a bijective isometry. The resulting square condition is modulo 3^(k−2) with s modulo 3^(k−1), giving the factor 3, with k=1 checked by the six-term pattern (2,0,0,1,2,0). That pattern forces any eventual period to be a multiple of six; applying a regular isometry forces 3^k to divide the half-period. The even sheet is already contained in the full 0 mod 3 ball. The odd sheet has measure (1/9)(3/8); counting its possible leading valuations yields the stated finite image sizes and zero fibers. Independently, recurrence-based enumeration of two tail blocks agreed on every fiber and the least period at k=1–6 (support sizes 3,7,20,58,173,517).
residual_risks: The finite check is bounded; the analytic proof supplies the all-depth conclusion. The claim does not apply to isolated transient values or identify a sharp starting index.

value.rationale: For a classical fixed Eulerian column, the result determines both which ternary residues can persist and how often every target occurs. The distinction between a quadratic sheet hidden inside a full residue ball and one visible in the support is structurally informative: an image-only theorem would miss the extra zero fibers. The exact period, compact value set and measure 17/24 give usable invariants at all depths.
residual_risks: No claims about other columns, other primes, or every initial transient residue are supported.
